Bug_Title: IM: Integer multiply of result of integer remainder (IM_MULTIPLYING_RESULT_OF_IREM)
Bug_Details:
The code multiplies the result of an integer remaining by an integer constant.
Be sure you don't have your operator precedence confused. For example
i % 60 * 1000 is (i % 60) * 1000, not i % (60 * 1000).
Bug_Explanation: The code demonstrates a bug where the result of an integer remainder operation is immediately multiplied by another integer constant. The expression i % 60 * 1000 is evaluated as (i % 60) * 1000 due to operator precedence, which might not be the intended calculation.

The method contains a multiplication of the result of an integer remainder operation by a constant, which is erroneously executed due to operator precedence. The test cases fail because the calculations do not match the expected results based on the operator precedence error.
